name: B10-0210/2024 (PPE) – Hong Kong, notably the cases of Jimmy Lai and the 45 activists recently convicted under the national security law
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Hong Kong, notably the cases of Jimmy Lai and the 45 activists recently convicted under the national security law
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of Jimmy Lai and 45 pro-democracy activists jailed in Hong Kong under national security laws. It condemns those laws and the treatment of detainees. It asks the European Union to consider sanctions on Hong Kong and Chinese officials, to watch trials and visit prisons, and to review the status of Hong Kong's trade office in Brussels. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament urges sanctions on Hong Kong and Chinese officials; it cannot impose them itself.
- It asks the European Union's foreign service to monitor trials and prisons and to review the Hong Kong trade office.
- It demands the release of Jimmy Lai and the 45 activists; Hong Kong authorities decide this.
